intro.text: A darkeyed man whose crew let Jushu Davar pile up a huge gambling debt.

items.text: Around 1170 Mill let Jushu Davar spend time with his crew while Jushu ran up gambling debts of nearly a hundred emerald broams, promising his father would pay. When Mill came to collect, he took Jushu captive to the Davar estate, but Lin Davar showed no sympathy and refused to pay.

Shallan went after Mill, who had beaten Jushu badly and was making him walk tied behind the carriage. She offered him her brothers' ceremonial knives and her necklace for Jushu. Mill valued them at about fifty broams and said killing a lighteyes would warn his other bettors, but she saw he was no gambler and argued the goods served him better than a death. He took the knives and let her keep the necklace.

appearance.text: He and his men wore old-fashioned Veden clothes, including the traditional ulatu, and he owned at least one carriage drawn by chulls.

personality.text: Mill spoke in a smooth, calm voice and carried himself haughtily for a darkeyes. Cold and calculating, he looked out only for himself, and he had once killed his own brother over an attempted scam.
